title: Dawn of the Observer
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji prepared to embark on a new journey, the Tianji Record suddenly trembled violently. The line of blood text slowly dissipated, replaced by golden inscriptions that had never appeared before—'Chapter 1155 Countdown: Thirty Days.' On the chessboard of fate, the final piece had been placed.

text.content: The bloodstained words burned onto the final page of the Tianji Record like a brand iron—'Chapter 1155, You Will Face the Final Trial'—Chen Ji gazed at these characters, his fingertips gently brushing across the ink, feeling the bone-deep chill emanating from within. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly on the first page before finally speaking: 'Master, the Tianji Record is complete. This means... you have completed the chess game of the first nine volumes. From now on, you will no longer be a piece, but the one who moves the pieces.' Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward, yet his eyes held no trace of relief: 'The one who moves the pieces? Mo Xiansheng, I prefer another title—the Observer.'

dialogue.content: 'Observer? What grandiose language.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a low laugh. 'Does the Master know that only one person in ten thousand years has set foot in this Heavenly Realm Core? For you to complete the entry within thirty days is to make an enemy of the ancient, unchanging order.' Chen Ji turned to look at the horizon, where an almost invisible gate of light was slowly forming: 'Order? I never make enemies of order. I'm simply telling it—it's time for a new master.'

text.content: The moment Chen Ji stepped into the Heavenly Realm Core, every hair on his body stood on end. Far from the gilded splendor he had imagined, this place was a pristine white void with only a massive stone platform at its center, covered in dense ancient runes. The air carried an indescribable aura—the scent of time itself, the weight of destiny. Three hundred years of planning, countless life-and-death decisions, had finally brought him here. Distant, measured footsteps echoed, each one seeming to fall upon Chen Ji's heartstrings.

dialogue.content: 'You've arrived.' A deep, resonant voice echoed through the space. Chen Ji looked up to see an elderly man in simple linen emerging from behind the stone platform, his face so ordinary it would be forgotten at a glance, yet his eyes were as profound as an abyss. He was Cang Yutian—that being who had reshaped heaven's mandate with mortal flesh and ultimately replaced the Heavenly Will to become the lord of the Heavenly Realm. Chen Ji clasped his hands in salute, neither servile nor arrogant: 'Junior Chen Ji, here to fulfill a three-hundred-year appointment.' Cang Yutian studied him, then suddenly smiled: 'Three hundred years? I was waiting for someone who could write destiny.'

choice.prompt: Facing this legendary figure, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Meet his gaze as an equal, displaying the confidence of one who moves the pieces
choices.risk_hint: If failed, may be stripped of Observer qualification

text.content: Chen Ji did not bow his head; instead, he met Cang Yutian's gaze with composure. Space seemed to freeze in that moment as the two consciousnesses clashed invisibly. Chen Ji felt a vast, ocean-like pressure surge toward him, yet he gritted his teeth and did not retreat a single step. 'Interesting.' A flicker of appreciation crossed Cang Yutian's eyes. 'You resemble my younger self greatly.'

choices.description: Maintain the usual low-key demeanor, first hear what terms he offers
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to demonstrate strength
choices.risk_hint: May be contemptuously dismissed by Cang Yutian

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed his body, his posture respectful yet not servile: 'The senior overpraises. This junior merely stumbled as a piece of destiny to arrive here.' Cang Yutian burst into laughter, the sound shaking the entire space: 'What fine 'stumbling'! None who reach this place are merely stumbling fools. You test me, and I likewise test you.'

Cang Yutian walked slowly toward the stone platform, placing his palm upon the runes. In an instant, the entire Heavenly Realm Core erupted in dazzling golden light. Countless runes flowed like water, ultimately converging into a massive scroll. Within the scroll appeared one hundred and eight crucial nodes, each marked with specific times and locations. 'This is the map of destiny I spent three hundred years painting.' Cang Yutian turned to look at Chen Ji. 'Now, it belongs to you.' Chen Ji stepped forward. The Tianji Record opened on its own, and the light from both instantly intertwined—one hundred and eight trials that must be experienced, one hundred and eight opportunities for transformation.

dialogue.content: The moment the two powers merged, a cold, sinister voice rang in Chen Ji's mind: 'You think replacing Cang Yutian will let you escape my chess game? Chen Ji, you are merely another, slightly larger piece.' It was the will of the Heavenly Eye—arriving earlier than Chen Ji had anticipated. Chen Ji coldly smiled in his heart: 'A piece? Then allow me to show you how this piece delivers checkmate.' He did not speak aloud, but new words already appeared on the Tianji Record—'The Heavenly Eye will launch its first trial in Chapter 1081.'

text.content: Cang Yutian pressed his palm against the stone platform, and golden light gushed from his palm, pouring into Chen Ji's Tianji Record. The light was warm as jade, yet upon contact it erupted with staggering force—Chen Ji felt his soul seem torn apart then reorganized. Countless insights about destiny flooded his consciousness like a tide. For three hundred years he had been fumbling through fog, and now the fog finally lifted, revealing the path to the other shore. 'From this day forward, you are the Observer of the Heavenly Realm Core.' Cang Yutian's voice was solemn as divine oracle. 'May you walk farther than I did.'

choice.prompt: Facing Cang Yutian's legacy, how should Chen Ji respond to this historic moment?

choices.text: Clasp hands with him in a solemn vow
choices.description: Complete the ceremony of old and new order transition in the most direct manner
choices.visible_reward: Gained complete inheritance acknowledgment from Cang Yutian, unlocking the full 'Observer' authority

text.content: Chen Ji extended his hand, palm facing upward. Cang Yutian paused slightly, then burst into hearty laughter, extending his palm as well. The two palms struck together, producing a crisp sound. In that moment, the entire Heavenly Realm Core trembled, countless points of light erupting from their palms and transforming into scattered stars across the sky. This was the transition of old and new orders, the end of a three-hundred-year chess game, and the beginning of a completely new fate. Cang Yutian looked at Chen Ji, his eyes filled with deep satisfaction: 'I have waited three hundred years for this day.'

choices.description: Express respect for the senior through traditional ritual
choices.visible_reward: Received additional gift from Cang Yutian
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may dislike elaborate formalities

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and performed a solemn three-bow toward Cang Yutian. Cang Yutian watched his movements, his expression shifting through various emotions before finally turning into a sigh: 'Rise. The formalities are complete; the path ahead must be walked by yourself.' He reached out and touched Chen Ji's brow center, and a wisp of golden light sank into it—that was a portion of Cang Yutian's three-hundred-year cultivation insights, which would become the key to Chen Ji's future breakthroughs.

choices.memory_label: 仓御天额外馈赠已获得

text.content: The resonance of the palm strike had not yet faded when the Tianji Record suddenly翻开 to its final page. Golden text surged like living creatures, slowly arranging before Chen Ji's eyes—all the key plot points of Volume 10, each line recording the imminent turning points of fate. The opening of the forbidden land in Chapter 108, the decisive battle against the Demonic Path in Chapter 500, the confrontation with Heavenly Dao in Chapter 1000... all the way to Chapter 1155—that final node marked in large golden characters, with four words written beside it: Death Prophecy. Chen Ji静静地注视着这行字，嘴角勾起一抹意味深长的弧度：「终于完整了。」

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned around, gazing toward that amber-colored horizon dyed by golden light. Everything in the Heavenly Realm Core lay beneath his feet—the flowing runes, the dormant laws, and the Heavenly Dao's accumulated fortune amassed over ten thousand years. He took out the Tianji Record from his怀, gently caressing the crack on its cover—that mark left when he first obtained this book three hundred years ago. 'Mo Xiansheng,' he called in his heart, 'what do you think—what should be the final move in this chess game?' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul沉默片刻，终于回答：「主人，天机录已经完整，我该告诉您最后的真相了——天道之眼，它并非单纯的反派，而是……」

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng is about to reveal the final truth—how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Need to know the complete truth now, regardless of the cost
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the core secret of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The truth may be crueler than imagined

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently: 'Heaven's Eye... it is not an enemy, but the previous master of the Tianji Record. It chose self-sacrifice, severing its own fate, to buy you three hundred years of growth time. Master, you always thought you were struggling against Heaven, but you didn't know... Heaven's Eye is your guardian.' Chen Ji stood frozen, the Tianji Record in his hand suddenly feeling heavier by ten thousand jun. So it turned out that this supposed archenemy had been a guardian all along.

choices.description: Perhaps some truths are better left unknown
choices.risk_hint: May fall into a passive position at the final moment

text.content: 「不必说了。」Chen Ji平静地打断他，「无论真相是什么，我都已经做出了选择。知道得太多，反而会束缚住自己的手脚。」Mo Xiansheng沉默了许久，最终发出一声意味深长的叹息：「主人，您比我想象中更成熟。好吧，既然如此，那些真相就留到最后一刻再揭晓吧。」Tianji Record上的文字缓缓消散，只留下那行触目惊心的金色标题。

Chen Ji walked slowly to the edge of the stone platform, gazing at the Void beneath his feet shrouded in golden light. Three hundred years of schemes, endless calculations, countless moments between life and death—all now transformed into the cornerstone beneath his feet. He closed his eyes, sensing the vast power emanating from the Heavenly Realm Core, an ancient and pure force that seemed to have existed in this space since time immemorial. "Fate is not a shackle." Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes, his voice soft yet clearly echoing throughout the entire space, "It is a canvas—and I, at last, have taken up my brush." His words rippled through the space, and those dormant runes seemed to sense something, all simultaneously erupting in brilliant radiance.

dialogue.content: At this very moment, a deep purple light suddenly pierced through from beyond the horizon, condensing into a vague humanoid form before Chen Ji. It was a projection of the Eye of Heavenly天道—the Will's mere tip of the iceberg, not its full appearance. It did not speak, but Chen Ji could feel the complex emotions within that gaze: expectation, scrutiny, and a barely perceptible sorrow. Chen Ji met its gaze without flinching: "You've been watching all along, haven't you? Watching from the very beginning." The projection gave a slight nod, then dissolved into scattered motes of light, leaving only a silent sigh lingering in the air.

text.content: The camera slowly pulled back. Beyond the Heavenly Realm Core, countless streams of light were converging from all directions—those were the threads of fate from parallel worlds, the countless possibilities of Chen Ji across infinite timelines. Some had already fallen midway, others remained trapped forever within the chess game, and still others had reached the end only to lose everything. Yet at this moment, all these possibilities were converging upon this Chen Ji, transforming into nourishment for his continued forward journey. The Tianji Record turned to its final page, and those blood characters had completely vanished, replaced by a brand-new golden inscription—"The Observer's Path, Now Officially Opened."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji cast one final glance at the stone platform that had承载了 three hundred years of memories, then turned toward the exit. His pace was unhurried, yet every step was solid and powerful. Cang Yutian watched his retreating figure disappear into the golden light, murmuring to himself: "This game of chess... played more brilliantly than I did back then." Beyond the Heavenly Realm Core, Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Han Lie, Ling Yuan... all those whose fates intertwined with Chen Ji simultaneously lifted their heads, sensing something. They knew a brand-new era was about to begin. And that once-scorned废物杂役弟子 had now risen to the pinnacle of fate, grasping the Tianji brush capable of rewriting everything.
